jobs.description:

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

Digital Technology’s Cyber GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) team is responsible for ensuring that Arup’s cybersecurity practices align with internal policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. The team manages cyber risks by developing governance frameworks, assessing threats, implementing controls, monitoring compliance, and supporting audits. Our goal is to reduce security risks while enabling business objectives in a secure and compliant manner

The Opportunity

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. Develop, maintain, and test the organisation’s IT Disaster Recovery (ITDR) plans
Conduct regular risk assessments and impact analyses to identify critical systems, dependencies, and recovery priorities.
Manage global cybersecurity awareness campaigns and training initiatives to strengthen security culture.
Collaborate with regional digital teams to embed security-by-design principles into projects and products.
Drive implementation and ongoing compliance with ISO 22301 standards, ensuring the organisation meets global BCM requirements.

Did you know:
Our Digital Technology team are proud prior winners of the IT Team of the Year at the Chartered Institute of IT’s UK IT Industry Awards.

Bring experience in threat and risk assessment.
Show enthusiasm for cyber awareness and education, with a desire to lead global initiatives that encourage cultural change.
Value ongoing learning and is motivated to develop further in a supportive, international, and innovative organisation.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Description

Veson Nautical is a well-established and rapidly growing software company working to provide end-to-end logistical, operational, and analytical solutions to propel the efficiency and effectiveness of Maritime Commerce.

The Opportunity

Internally, this position is known as a Senior Commercial Solutions Consultant. As an integral part of the sales team, this role helps envision, architect, and articulate tailored solutions for prospects and existing clients across our multi-product portfolio. This position drives revenue growth by delivering strategic pre-sales expertise in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment—combining deep technical and functional knowledge with proven ability to sell complex SaaS solutions to enterprise organizations. The role requires balancing sophisticated commercial engagements with systematic firm-building activities that multiply team impact. The role also requires the ability to apply product, industry knowledge and soft skills to deliver excellence during commercial engagements.

Responsibilities

Core Pre-Sales Activities:

Deliver deep-dive product demonstrations and presentations tailored to prospect business objectives and technical requirements
Lead technical evaluations including POCs, RFPs, and complex solution design across multiple product combinations
Develop initial SOWs and Professional Services estimates, validating Veson's deployment capability against customer needs
Act as liaison between sales and broader Veson organization for specialized technical assistance
Collaborate with Sales, Services, and Product teams to articulate Veson's value proposition, vision, and strategy
Build credibility with prospects and clients through demonstrated expertise in both business value and technical implementation

Solution Design & Technical Leadership

Design and scope integration requirements during pre-sales stage, articulating technical feasibility and implementation approach
Serve as go-to internal technical resource, educating sales teammates, clients, and prospects on Veson's offerings
Regionally own sales demo and sandbox environments, streamlining and creatively developing crisp demonstration experiences
Use deep product knowledge and technical skills to suggest and potentially develop tailored product solutions

Strategic Engagement & Discovery

Conduct strategic discovery using MEDDPICC methodology to uncover pain points, decision criteria, and business metrics
Present to executive stakeholders, effectively communicating business benefits (value proposition) and technical advantages
Support sales team in building and executing account-specific close strategies
Leverage AI tools (particularly Claude) to accelerate preparation, content creation, and knowledge management
Maintain accurate Salesforce documentation regarding client/prospect input, opportunity wins, and losses

Firm-Building & Team Contribution

Partner with commercial team while balancing buyer-facing engagements with internal capability-building activities
Contribute to SC team structure improvements, process optimization, and knowledge sharing
Create reusable content assets (Consensus demos, discovery frameworks, technical documentation) that scale team impact
Mentor and provide thought leadership to associate-level colleagues
Travel as needed (up to 25%) within assigned region and occasionally globally

Communications & Relationships

Internal

Collaborates extensively with Sales, Services, Product Management, and Marketing to design and deliver tailored solutions
Provides technical expertise and thought leadership to wider SC team
Regular contributor of client and market insights to Product team for roadmap prioritization
Mentors Associate/Consultant-level colleagues on technical and commercial skills

External

Acts as trusted advisor to prospects and clients, engaging technical teams and senior decision-makers
Leads solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, workshops, and technical evaluations
Represents Veson in regional client-facing activities (conferences, industry events, strategic workshops)
Builds credibility through demonstrated expertise in solving business problems

Experience

Qualifications:

7+ years of pre-sales, solutions consulting, or technical sales experience in enterprise SaaS
Proven track record in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments supporting a multi-product portfolio
Experience engaging and presenting to senior stakeholders across the full sales cycle
Comfortable to proficient with AI tools, particularly Claude
Strong working knowledge of commercial applications (MS Office, Salesforce, LinkedIn, demo platforms)
Technical aptitude for APIs, cloud architecture, and system integrations
Fast learner who independently absorbs new product and industry knowledge
Exceptional written and oral communication skills with a passion for educating clients and teammates
Highly coachable, detail-oriented, and effective under pressure
Collaborative by nature with a creative, solutions-first approach

Demonstrated Mastery In Several Of The Following Core Competencies

Strategic Discovery & Qualification (MEDDPICC framework)
Value Communication & Storytelling
Demo Excellence & Technical Presentation
Competitive Positioning & Objection Handling
Stakeholder Management & Influence
Technical Acumen (APIs, integrations, cloud architecture)
AI Fluency & Productivity

Language Requirements

Fluent English (required)
Spanish, Greek, or Japanese fluency (highly desirable based on regional assignment)
Regional language proficiency preferred (e.g., Japanese for APAC, Greek for EMEA)

About Veson Nautical

We are a team of multi-cultural, multi-disciplined professionals that are dedicated to making our clients successful and charting a new, innovative course for the commercial marine industry. Veson Nautical employs a staff of extremely capable creators and innovators all focused on meeting the goals of our clients. We invest extensively in employee development and experience to maintain focus and enthusiasm. The Veson Nautical team is made up of a dynamic blend of engineers, artists, sailors, teachers, brokers, bankers, traders, consultants, and customer service experts.

Veson Nautical is a successful, rapidly growing global software company. Our clients are the world’s leading commercial maritime owners, operators and commodity trading companies. Veson’s solutions enable our clients to identify new opportunities and proactively manage their business to make more profitable decisions. With offices in Singapore, Tokyo, London, Athens, Houston and headquarters in Boston, USA, Veson Nautical is a dynamic organization with a committed team of professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the highest levels of client satisfaction, Veson Nautical brings decades of experience, technical knowledge, enthusiasm and commitment to clients around the world. The combination of exceptional market growth and leading market position make this a superb opportunity for the right candidate.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

SALARY RANGE: $94,759.86 - $94,759.86

Works under the general direction of the OEM (Office of Emergency Management) Manager to develop, coordinate, and oversee emergency/disaster plans for City of Memphis. Oversees and provides work direction, assignment of duties, evaluation of work performance, and discipline of assigned Emergency Management Specialists. Provides prevention, protection, mitigation, response, and recovery to mission areas. Coordinates the mission areas with various entities requesting assistance. Serves as a functional component of preparedness to direct the exercising, training, and equipping of first responders, private partners, and citizens. Assigns tasks according to mission assignments. Supervises the development and review of plans associated with prevention from, response to, recovery from, and mitigation of any natural and man-made disaster or major emergency. Attends and coordinates stakeholder meetings, workshops, seminars, and conferences. Acts as Planning Section Chief during Emergency Operations Center activations. Works with local schools and businesses to assist with emergency planning efforts. Works with other agencies of the National Incident Management System (NIMS) to manage incidents involving all threats and hazards to reduce loss of life, property, and harm to the environment. Ensures compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local policies, procedures, regulations, and legislation. Travels and attends various meetings, businesses and work sites across the City. Administers and/or assists with presentations, Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) classes. Conducts and coordinates planning meetings. Manages grant preparation and submission for the division. Conducts training and exercise

programs.

Responsibilities

OTHER FUNCTIONS:

Assumes responsibilities of OEM Manager as necessary.
Performs additional functions (essential or otherwise) which may be assigned.

Typical Physical Demands

Requires ability to communicate information to staff and general public, including the media, under stressful conditions during emergency situations. Requires the ability to operate radio console, telephone, and computer. Requires lifting objects (such as emergency equipment) weighing up to 50 lbs. Must be able to operate an automobile and/or emergency vehicle.

Typical Working Conditions

Work is performed in a highly secured office work area. Requires working from mobile unit or outdoors in all types of weather conditions during emergency and simulated emergency situations. Requires the ability to travel throughout the city, county, state, and country for work-related training sessions and meetings. Requires travel throughout the City for emergency-related site visits and situations. Oversees emergency management activities for the City of Memphis twenty-four (24) hours a day, seven (7) days a week operation.

Qualifications

High school diploma and eight (8) years in emergency management or firefighting activities, or any combination of experience and training which enables one to perform the essential job functions. Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license as a condition of continued employment.

Special Requirements

Requires being on-call seven (7) days a week, twenty-four (24) hours a day. Must complete the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Independent Home Study Courses and Professional Development Series including IS2200 Intermediate Emergency Operations Center Functions and Hazardous Materials Awareness by the end of one (1) year as a condition of continued employment. Must complete Memphis Fire Department (MFD) Tier 1 Professional Development within one (1) year and any MFD or city mandated training as required. Must continue to satisfy training requirements as determined by federal or state authorities, including certification programs which may be developed as a condition of continued employment.

Hallmark Healthcare Solutions, Inc. (HHCS) is seeking a Customer Success Manager to lead the post-go-live support of our Physician Enterprise Suite. Develop and maintain a complete understanding of the Physician Enterprise solutions, including system functionality, data flows, reporting, configuration, and calculation logic.
Supervise, coach, and support Customer Success Specialists, providing guidance on prioritization, issue resolution, client communication, and performance.

Ensure support cases, client decisions, project plans, resolutions, and recurring issues are documented accurately and timely.

Support customer satisfaction, retention, and renewal readiness through proactive engagement and effective issue management.

Previous experience supervising, coaching, mentoring, or leading team members.

Experience managing multiple clients, priorities, deadlines, and escalations in a fast-paced environment.

new_jobs.title: Senior Compliance Analyst - Due Diligence & Compliance Testing
new_jobs.description:
SUMMARY
The Senior Compliance Analyst is responsible for assisting the Chief Compliance Officer and Manager, Corporate Compliance in the oversight, investigation, documenting and resolving of compliance matters from a due diligence, risk, and regulatory standpoint as it pertains to Ultimus Fund Solutions (UFS).

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
COMPLIANCE TESTING
Conducts and coordinates compliance testing of UFS policies and procedures.
Provides feedback and suggestions on compliance with test planning, assessment of test results and control enhancements (if applicable) with controls owners.
Assists the Manager, Corporate Compliance and control owners in evaluating key risk indicators.
Assists in updating UFS Compliance Manual, as required, by suggesting edits based on results of recent compliance testing.

COMPLIANCE ADMINISTRATION
Supports administration of UFS Compliance Program, including the UFS Enterprise Risk Management Program.
Maintains resources utilized by the Corporate Compliance team to support Compliance testing, such as client or fund listings.
Prepares the initial draft of quarterly compliance certifications.
Prepares and supports various compliance related committees and working groups, including preparation of meeting materials, maintenance of meeting minutes and tracking of follow-up and deliverables.
Assists with monitoring adherence to UFS Policies and Procedures.
Escalates issues of concern immediately to Chief Compliance Officer.
Presents compliance testing results and recommendations to UFS Pricing Committee and UFS Compliance Committee.
Assists with preparation for regulatory examinations and audits; provides support during examinations and audits.

WORKING RELATIONSHIPS
Mentors associates through instruction, coaching, providing real-time on-the-job experiences, modeling effective practices, and advising on methods used.
Daily contact with Corporate Compliance associates.
Daily contact with internal associates while performing routine compliance testing of UFS policies and procedures.

May perform other duties as required and assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field.
5+ years of related compliance experience.
Experience working in Financial Services industry.
Equivalent education and experience will be considered.

KNOWLEDGE
SEC and FINRA rules and regulations.
Microsoft Office Suite.
Adobe Acrobat.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES
Aligns associates with company values and goals.
Plans and delegates the work of others.
Motivates and inspires others.
Assesses the performance of self and associates to make improvements or take corrective action.
Plans and develops systems and procedures to improve operating quality and efficiency of department in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Troubleshoots issues utilizing creative and critical thinking skills.
Multitasking, analytical, and organizational skills.
Initiative-taking, strategic, and meticulous approaches with a strong commitment to quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Demonstrates personal integrity, responsibility, and accountability.
Effectively uses resources such as time and information in conjunction with associates.
Participates in solving problems and making decisions.
Presents and expresses ideas and information, written and oral, clearly, and concisely.
Actively listens to others to achieve understanding and supports an open exchange of ideas and information.
Identifies needs, arranges for, and obtains resources to accomplish individual and department goals.
Establishes and develops effective working relationships with associates and clientele during both favorable and unfavorable situations.
Modifies team and individual priorities and deadlines in response to added information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles and ensures completion.
